title: Paper Published
content: After a year of working on it, my paper, 'Hooked on a Feeling: A Computational Approach Towards Understanding Songwriting as Cultural Memory', has been accepted for publication at the *Digital Studies / Le champ numérique (DSCN)*. [Read it here](https://www.digitalstudies.org/article/id/23539/)

title: Preprint Published
content: My senior project thesis, 'LLM-Enhanced Wearables for Comprehensible Health Guidance in LMICs', is now available as a preprint on arXiv. [Read it here](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.08701)
